title: MathAgent proof step-ledger
description: A proof represented as a DAG of justified steps. See agent/PLAN.md Section 5 (Layer 1).

problem.description: Identifier of the problem this ledger proves (e.g. a benchmarks/problems folder name).

claim.description: The theorem statement the ledger establishes (mirrors the terminal step's claim).

id.description: Unique step id within the ledger.

claim.description: The mathematical statement this step establishes.

justification.description: A key from the allowed-toolkit vocabulary (agent/gates/allowed_toolkit.yaml). Validated against the loaded toolkit, not hard-coded here.

depends_on.description: Ids of steps used as premises (defines the proof DAG edges).

method_ref.description: Optional path to a knowledge/methods/*.md file backing this step.

obligations.description: Structured proof obligations a justification must discharge. The required shape depends on the justification's obligation kind (see allowed_toolkit.yaml). Unknown obligation keys are rejected.

residues.description: Residues (mod modulus) the case split enumerates; must cover a complete residue system.

measure_expr.description: Optional: measure as an evaluable expression of the variables.

next_expr.description: Optional: the constructed smaller witness's measure expression, for a numeric decrease spot-check.

coprimality_from.description: Id of the prior step establishing the coprimality this square-split relies on.
